items.heading: The Number That Matters
items.text: The number that matters is the full two-year cost, tuition, housing, food, health insurance, and visa fees, not the tuition line alone that shows up in a university's marketing email. That full number changes sharply depending on which tier of university you can realistically get into and which city that university sits in.

items.heading: The Earning Side
items.text: The earning side of the equation has two separate parts most students blur together: how much you can earn, and how long you are legally allowed to earn it before the visa question forces a decision.
